headline: A beauty brand needed to look as professional on paper as it did in the mirror.
challenge: Beauty and personal-care ventures often launch on reputation and word of mouth, but formal registration and a growth plan are what turn a brand into a business.
delivered: Business development advisory on market positioning and growth
Administrative and documentation support for supplier and client contracts
impact: A personal-care brand formally recognised, structured for growth, and positioned to pursue retail partnerships with the paperwork to back it up.
